heroSummary: Gilbert Public Schools started the 2025–26 school year on Tuesday, July 22, 2025, and listed Thursday, May 21, 2026, as the last day for students. The GPS family calendar includes 180 student days, one-hour early releases, K-12 half days, K-6 parent-teacher conference half days, and a June 1–26 summer school window.
calendarNotes: The 2025–26 GPS family calendar separates one-hour early releases from K-12 half days, K-6 parent-teacher conference half days, semester half days, grading days, and summer school.

The PDF lists 1st Semester – 94 Days, 2nd Semester – 86 Days, and Total – 180 Days.
The PDF carries a Revised 05/16/23 notation.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Gilbert Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Gilbert Public Schools started the 2025–26 school year on Tuesday, July 22, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Gilbert Public Schools fall break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall break ran from Monday, September 29, through Friday, October 10, 2025. Students returned Monday, October 13.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded Gilbert calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later Gilbert Public Schools revisions.
